text:
reena: spotted a weird one in prod after the Docusaurus rollout: /guides/ops#retry-policy jumps to the wrong subsection. The HTML contains two elements with id="retry-policy" — looks like a heading and an adjacent admonition block both generated the same slug. noah: oof. i've seen duplicate-id churn when we have `:::note` MDX admonitions immediately after headings. docusaurus slugifier sometimes normalizes both headings and the admonition title. harper: can you paste the built HTML snippet? reena: sure — from build/static/docs/guides/ops.html: 
<h3 id="retry-policy">Retry policy</h3>
<div class="admonition note" id="retry-policy">
  <p>This is important for idempotency...</p>
</div>
noah: yep that's the problem — duplicate id. Browsers will jump to the first match which in our case is the heading but in some localized builds the order flips. We need deterministic ids. harper: short-term fix: add an explicit id on the heading (e.g. `### Retry policy {#retry-policy}`) and prefer admonitions with a different id if they need one (or avoid admonition titles). Long-term: we should tweak the mdx plugin to avoid generating ids on admonition wrappers. reena: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5233 — changes: (1) add explicit ids to the 6 pages where duplicate ids were found, (2) update linkcheck to assert unique ids per page, (3) add a small remark in the contributor guide: "avoid heading-adjacent admonition titles; prefer explicit heading ids." link-bot: buildkite/docs-validate #1217 failed: duplicate id `retry-policy` in /guides/ops (exit=1). noah: i pushed a tiny mdx plugin patch in the PR that strips generated ids from admonition wrappers: `if (node.type === 'admonition') node.data.hProperties.id = null`. this prevents the wrapper from colliding with headings. i've left tests. harper: nice. careful with nulling ids - ensure other features (like clickable admonition-permalink) aren't impacted. run the accessibility checks. reena: ran local `yarn build && node scripts/check_unique_ids.js build` — now passes. marking PR ready. link-bot: buildkite/docs-validate #1219 started (includes unique-id check). link-bot: buildkite/docs-validate #1219 succeeded: unique id check passed, no duplicate fragments. merged at 3185550055. noah: follow-up: adding a CI lint that rejects generated HTML with duplicate ids and a styleguide entry: "When adding admonitions immediately after a heading, either omit the admonition title or add explicit, distinct ids." harper: filing a follow-up issue to audit `/:locale` builds for duplicate-id regressions; i18n sometimes reorders blocks and flips which id is first. reena: thanks all — release note blurb: "docs: fix duplicate-heading/admonition IDs causing broken fragment jumps; add unique-id check to docs CI; prefer explicit header ids and avoid admonition titles adjacent to headings."
